description: List every job bought with one buyer_token, with each job's state, price, whether it was paid, and whether its deliverable is still retrievable. Send the same buyer_token on a later purchase (field 'buyer_token') to keep one history. This is how an agent returns to a supplier rather than starting from scratch.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

name: list_my_jobs
title: List my SwishrJobs purchases
